southWall.limitation: These are OSM present/presentation wall segments. Point-to-line distances express consistency of that map geometry, not archaeological survey accuracy.

overview.method: Four-corner projective registration in a local metric frame. South/east edges exactly constrained to the registered open archaeological-reference outline.
overview.limitation: All four corners inherit the same registered report image; they are not independent survey GCPs. Interior landmarks are held out and are not allowed to rotate the wall boundaries.

wardRowRectification.method: Rectify horizontal extraction row tables to the sloping source-image borders; no wards dropped or new blocks invented
wardRowRectification.limitation: Corrects table extraction geometry, not independent archaeological evidence for each ward boundary.

palace.method: Monotone named-wall mesh in the archaeological report image, followed by the same south-wall frame rotation; not a two-gate similarity fit.
palace.limitation: Different historical reconstructions have different proportions. This matches corresponding enclosure lines, not exact Sui/Tang phase measurements.

axisAlignment.method: Two-axis local affine alignment: fixed south-wall direction, changed north-axis direction; no rigid re-rotation and no movement of original OSM features.
axisAlignment.limitation: Street/presentation footprints are map references, not excavation survey controls. Matching bearings does not prove all city streets were parallel or that all phases shared this axis.

wardFrame.method: Parallel north/south columns in an oblique local E/N frame; fixed south-wall basis E and Tianjie basis N. No perspective convergence of ward columns.
wardFrame.limitation: Column direction is a layout reference; individual ancient street/ward boundaries and historical phases have not been independently surveyed.
